interpretation: A candidate-consistent verdict for labelled fake-framework data validates analysis logic only. Human review of separately authorised real operating-state measurements is still required; no live provider is qualified.
limits: Actual constant, wrong-trend and marker-only timelines fail candidate-consistent acceptance.
Additional labelled data mutations test missing/stale records, inconsistent clocks/raw bits/context, identity, stream triplets, marker progression, writer/producer status and summary counts.
Gear and actual throttle remain unavailable; keyboard intent and phase requests are not achieved-state proof.
privacy: Only portable file labels, hashes, named checks and summary verdicts are included; no private paths, identifiers, raw handles, addresses or absolute QPC values.
